“《倾城》剧组那边公司已经处理好了，但是违约金得从你片酬里面扣。”唐隐顿了顿，略带疑惑，“这个剧本真的很烂，你当初为什么要接？”

时笙耸耸肩，“米兰安排的，我一个十八线开外的小明星，哪里有资格和一个金牌经纪人叫板。”

闻言，唐隐越发对这个自荐上门的艺人表示好奇，自从他接了她，公司直接给了他单独的办公室，甚至是好资源都往他这里送，这对一个还没带过艺人的新人来说，简直是天上掉馅饼了。

不知为何，他隐隐有种被坑了的感觉。

压下心底的怪异，唐隐将三本剧本递给时笙，“这是我选过的剧本，你挑一下。”

时笙只看了眼名字，就将其中一本挑了出来，“就这部。”

唐隐没有反对，这三本都是他选出来，随便她怎么选，都不会太差。

时笙选中的是仙侠电视剧，讲述修真宗门玄宗被人灭门后，仅剩一口气的弟子青宴，被一株修炼成妖的桃花树所救，一人一妖踏上寻找玄宗被灭真相的故事。

这是网络小说改编的，算是近年仙侠中，名气较大的一部。

时笙要试镜的不是女主桃花妖，而是女三，出身不凡，不过结局不太好。

“有把握吗？”唐隐很不确定的问。

他看过她演的戏，演技并不怎么好，但是这部电视剧中，女三却是一个极为重要的角色，前期女三俏皮活泼，后期，女三会黑化，变得冷漠无情，两极化的性格不是那么好演绎的。

他看中的是女二的角色，虽然以她的资质不一定拿得到……

谁知道，她选的竟然是女三。

时笙合上剧本，露出一口白牙，“试试不就知道了。”

唐隐深深的看了她一眼，带着她上楼，到试镜的楼层。电梯刚打开，就看到米兰带着一个青春靓丽的女生迎面而来。

米兰看到时笙，眼底有些厌恶，更多的不满和恨意。

她竟然放着她这个金牌经纪人不跟，跑去跟一个刚进公司的新人，这不是打她的脸么？

当然，更多的原因，是因为那支团队。

“米兰姐。”唐隐不咸不淡的打了声招呼，余光扫了一眼那个女生，眸色深了几分。

米兰微微颔首，标准化的笑了笑，有些时候，表面功夫还是要做的。

"The crew of "Allure" has been taken care of by the company, but the liquidated damages will be deducted from your salary." Tang Yin paused, a little confused, "This script is really bad, why did you accept it in the first place?"

Shi Sheng shrugged, "It was arranged by Milan. How can I, a little star outside the 18th line, be qualified to challenge a gold medal agent?"

Hearing this, Tang Yin became more and more curious about this self-recommended artist. Since he picked her up, the company has directly given him a separate office and even sent him good resources. For a newcomer who has never brought up an artist before, this is like pie in the sky.

For some reason, he felt vaguely like he had been cheated.

Suppressing the weirdness in his heart, Tang Yin handed three scripts to Shi Sheng, "These are the scripts I have chosen. You take your pick."

Shi Sheng only glanced at the name and picked out one of the books, "This is the one."

Tang Yin had no objection. He had chosen these three books. No matter what she chose, they would not be too bad.

Shi Sheng chose the Xianxia TV series, which tells the story of Qing Yan, a disciple of the cultivating sect Xuan Zong who was wiped out. He was rescued by a peach blossom tree that became a demon. One person and one demon set out to find the truth about Xuan Zong's destruction.

This is an adaptation of an online novel, and it is considered one of the more famous among Xianxia in recent years.

The one Shi Sheng wants to audition for is not the heroine Peach Blossom Demon, but the third female lead, who has an extraordinary background, but the ending is not good.

"Are you sure?" Tang Yin asked uncertainly.

He has seen her acting, and her acting skills are not very good, but in this TV series, the third female lead is an extremely important role. In the early stage, the third female lead is playful and lively, but in the later stage, the third female lead will darken and become cold and ruthless. The polarized character is not so easy to interpret.

He is interested in the role of the second female lead, although she may not be able to get it due to her qualifications...

Who knew that she would choose the third female lead.

Shi Sheng closed the script and showed his white teeth, "You'll know if you try it."

Tang Yin took a deep look at her and took her upstairs to the audition floor.As soon as the elevator opened, I saw Milan coming towards me with a young and beautiful girl.

When Milan saw Shi Sheng, his eyes were filled with disgust, more dissatisfaction and hatred.

She actually ignored her, a gold medal agent, and went to follow a newcomer who had just joined the company. Wasn't this a slap in her face?

Of course, the more reason is because of the team.

"Sister Milan." Tang Yin greeted her politely. He glanced at the girl from the corner of his eye and his eyes darkened a bit.

Milan nodded slightly and smiled in a normal way. Sometimes, superficiality still needs to be done.
